name: OWASP Slack
discord_description: The official OWASP community workspace for chapter and project discussion, security announcements, and connecting with application-security practitioners and leaders.
candidate_notes: Durable self-service page on owasp.org that issues Slack access directly.

name: BloodHound / SpecterOps Slack
discord_description: Community for BloodHound users covering Active Directory and Entra ID attack-path analysis, tool usage, and detection engineering discussion.
candidate_notes: ghst.ly/BHSlack is SpecterOps' own standing shortlink; it forwards to a rotating shared_invite, but the short link itself is the durable public entry point.

name: Hack Club Slack
discord_description: A large maker/hacker community for teenagers who build software and hardware projects together, with peer 'Gardener' mentors to help newcomers.
candidate_notes: Good on-ramp for teen beginners; broader than pure security but has active security/CTF channels.

name: MacAdmins Slack
discord_description: Large IT/Mac-admin community with an active #security channel covering endpoint security, MDM hardening, and macOS/iOS security tooling.
candidate_notes: Code of Conduct acceptance required at signup; run by the nonprofit Mac Admins Foundation.

name: Kubernetes Slack
discord_description: Official Kubernetes community Slack, including #sig-security and #falco channels for cluster and workload security discussion.
candidate_notes: slack.k8s.io is Kubernetes' own durable redirect (currently to an inviter.co page); also the home of the Falco community channel.

name: Binary Ninja Slack
discord_description: Community for users of the Binary Ninja reverse-engineering platform, covering plugin development, analysis techniques, and support.
candidate_notes: Durable vendor-hosted redirect to a shared_invite link.
